contracts.docstring: Run one explicit local administration action; help never reads assets, initializes data or downloads.
Remove unused latest migration58 with the service stopped; used history requires forward repair.
Read bounded, stable files under one project upload root; never arbitrary paths.
Acquire one stable byte snapshot, then extract supported text with provenance.
Identify an upload and optional byte-bound historical provenance preserved during capture.
Own scoped source/finding/report/wiki transactions, revocable grants and atomic effect receipts.
Resolve a project-scoped upload with any original imported identity and its expected byte hash.
Repair only Git administrative path files, preserving commits, branches, indexes and dirty worktrees.
Read one bounded JSON manifest through the same no-follow path contract as copied data.

Copy raw export evidence and retain each exact text fragment under an explicit owner project.

Metadata-only records remain in the export/provenance receipt. No complete
document, citation, task association or reviewed finding is inferred.
Validate explicit disjoint source roots and logical prefixes before creating any output.
Resolve an exact stored or actual absolute path through one unambiguous operator mapping.
Copy raw trees with stable inventories and hashes, then repair only copied Git path metadata.
Read only exact mapped UTF8 reports missing database content; preserve existing bodies and IDs.
Normalize uploads and relocate current repositories/worktrees, preserving their IDs and old paths in receipts.

Create one pending managed installation from a locked legacy snapshot and explicitly mapped files.

Native databases require backup-host and their independent authority evidence.
Partial failures never publish installation.json; retry only at a NEW path.
Prepare schema17 with container paths, same-named reports and cross-root linked Git storage.
Actual Git/SQLite migration retains old data and remains blocked until explicit fresh enrollment.
Ambiguous/outside/missing bytes and native installations cannot bypass preservation or authority rules.
The normal readers serve hydrated content by original ID and reject a different project's access.
The installed administrative command stages data without credentials or automatic enrollment.
Build a portable-format fixture; the separate integration trial uses the real pinned Chroma reader.
Bind each fixture file to its exact raw bytes rather than claimed record counts alone.
Same IDs in separate collections and misleading metadata cannot override an explicit project assignment.
Unassigned, corrupt or incomplete legacy text cannot become a completed native installation.
A consistent SQLite snapshot includes committed WAL rows even while the original connection stays open.
An owned child exit after data commits cannot publish a usable host or erase the recovery source.
Reach every supported post-legacy version, then repeat startup without losing IDs or relations.
Abruptly kill only a new migration child before its history insert, then recover that same DB.
Unknown targets and booleans cannot create a partial installation as a side effect.
A forward migration cannot hide a future version, fill a fabricated gap or act as downgrade.
Old-kernel peers retain uncertainty and gain explicit archival provenance in the restored copy.
An unused latest step can be reversed; a future schema is never silently downgraded.
Run the pinned legacy reader with no network namespace and writes confined to this fixture root.
Create an original schema17 database and a report whose body exists only at a mapped host path.
Capture one imported fragment through normal source APIs and verify its preserved identity and text.
Enroll with synthetic account material, start the installed native API and read retained scoped data.
Run one NEW synthetic compatibility trial with installed backend and an isolated pinned export environment.
Hash one regular snapshot file for the portable export manifest.
List raw regular storage without following links or accepting special filesystem entries.
Capture consistent SQLite and stable index files while retaining the original application rows.
Preserve raw storage and export every selected collection record with exact text/metadata/identity.
Run one explicit new-copy compatibility export without loading serving credentials or providers.

scope: All new/changed Python definitions and affected modules in this delivery carry English docstrings. No claim that all historical project definitions are documented.
